style_en: Japanese TV anime style, crisp clean line art, cel-shaded coloring, calm muted colors, bright even lighting, ancient Japan Kofun-period clothing (mizura hair loops, kinu tunic, hakama trousers). Background must be pure white.
avoid_en: text, letters, logos, modern buildings or clothes, Chinese-style robes, nudity, blood, a second separate person

urashima.desc_en: Urashimako, a handsome young fisherman of ancient Tango in Japan about 22 years old, a calm gentle face with clear dark eyes, black hair tied in mizura loops beside both ears, a plain undyed hemp Kofun-period tunic with a dark blue sash and hemp trousers tied below the knees with cords, a small string of white shell beads, barefoot

kamehime.desc_en: Kamehime, a beautiful otherworldly young woman of ancient Japan about 20 years old, very long straight black hair loosely tied at the back, a fully covering pale white Kofun-period kinu tunic with long sleeves over a long mo skirt shaded in five soft colors (blue, yellow, red, white, black like a turtle shell), a sheer pale scarf over the shoulders, a string of pearls, a calm mysterious face

urashima_old.desc_en: Urashimako grown suddenly very old, a thin bent old man about 80 years old with long white hair loosely in mizura loops, a deeply wrinkled face, the same plain undyed hemp Kofun-period tunic with a dark blue sash and hemp trousers, barefoot
